source_crosscheck.checkpoint: Metal4MainAttachments.h:288-310 has the same stage masks and depth crop.
source_crosscheck.split: Metal4WorldRenderer.mm:5118-5134 emits the F→F split; :5354-5370 closes G before first opaque MRT.
source_crosscheck.attachments: Metal4WorldRenderer.mm:4945-4964 loadedMainPass165 checks exact color/depth/stencil texture identities, single sample, Load/Store, no resolve/extra color; :5033-5055 and :5120-5122 require the gate at admission and split. The same pass descriptor is reused for G.
source_crosscheck.reads: Metal4Grass.mm:65-132 checks active V texture root disjointness and standalone storage, exact read callbacks, device/type/sample and immutable buffers. Source check was required by the positive split; the capture export does not expose physical owner/alias identity.
source_crosscheck.shader_identity: shader-stage-intervals.jsonl and shader-costs.jsonl directly map @rps12 to GrassVertex/GrassFragment and @rps16/@rps71 to GameDecalFragment/GroundDecalFragment. The render-pipelines listing alone lacks entrypoint names, but the combined exports provide direct identity.

unknown_from_exports: The API export omits render-pass descriptor attachment texture IDs, load/store actions, resolve attachments and source-level roots. Therefore it cannot independently establish A/G attachment equality or exact Load/Store; that conclusion is conditional on the frozen source gate.

The resources export lists categories and counts, not individual texture parent/root/heap/IOSurface/shareable properties or allocation IDs. The six argument-table resource IDs do not prove physical non-aliasing with A outputs.

The export does not give exact source-generation, last-writer stage/version or GPU completion for Grass slots 1-5. The checkpoint mask proves ordering for qualifying prior Fragment/Dispatch/Blit writers, while runtime provider/alias gate is the source-level proof of qualification.

The API order and barriers show permitted stage overlap, not actual overlap duration, performance gain or whole-frame visual parity. Shader interval attribution belongs to the separate trace analysis.
sdk_stage_basis: /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk/System/Library/Frameworks/Metal.framework/Headers/MTLCommandEncoder.h:45-66 defines V=1,F=2,Dispatch=1<<27,Blit=1<<28; MTL4CommandEncoder.h:48-93 defines queue barrier scope and Device visibility.
conclusion: The captured API sequence confirms the intended checkpoint, one A→G Fragment-only split, eight directly identified Grass G draws and preserved G→next-render boundary. Combined shader exports identify A GameDecal/GroundDecal Fragment and G Grass Vertex/Fragment. Attachment/root, physical alias and exact producer-version claims remain source-gated and are not independently certified by these exports.
